newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea panel to delay finance reform presentation.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea panel to delay finance reform presentation.

text.p: A South Korean presidential panel will delay the scheduled May 26 presentation of financial reform proposals to President Kim Young-sam until later in May, a finance ministry spokesman said on Wednesday.
He said the delay was necessary because the country's finance minister would not return to Seoul from an Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development meeting in Paris until May 28.
The commission is scheduled to meet on Friday to put the finishing touches on the proposals.
The 31-member commission was set up in January after President Kim said he would push forward with reforming the country's backward financial sector.
